govdocs-archive_org-nsia-NewOrleansLawEn: FBI officials wrote this memorandum between November 22 and 26, 1963, in the first days after the assassination. Their problem was legal: they were searching for a federal statute that covered the assassination of a president. At that time, killing a president was not itself a federal crime, a gap Congress later closed. The file preserves the search under its heading, without summarizing the lawyers' conclusions.
